Tools for Data Collection
Client interview and subsequent data collection can be orga-
nized using a number of tools and instruments. Many facilities
design their own tools and instruments so that they can collect
and organize the health information for easy use. Additionally, 
there are standardized forms such as the DETERMINE check-
list11 Subjective Global Assessment,12, 13 and numerous other
instruments that are used for speciﬁ c populations (see Appen-
dix D). ADA’s evidence-based analysis for nutrition screen-
